tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, job card, transcript sample, disabled button fill. Sits on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders on paper or surface. Decorative only, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and logo bars on paper or surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on paper or surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, links, timestamps, active tab, progress fill. One primary button per screen.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts.

tokens.name: on-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Text and links on accent-tint.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts, such as trial used up.

tokens.name: on-warning-tint
tokens.usage: Text and links on warning-tint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid field border, cancel button text and border on paper or surface.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts.

tokens.name: on-danger-tint
tokens.usage: Text on danger-tint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; padding in compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between component groups.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding, column gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Progress bar, logo bars, cover art thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, alerts. The only corner radius for controls; no pills.
